value.title: One interior label per original tiled polygon without another object layer
value.statement: Direct SQLite polygon tiles retain unlabelled polygon fragments and at most one marked Point label record per original feature at each canonical zoom in the same features source-layer. The anchor is calculated before clipping on the largest usable original part with holes, checked after MVT rounding, and assigned to exactly one unbuffered owner tile. No global point collection, additional object layer, source or native style layer is allocated. Geometry without a representable interior anchor at a zoom has no label there; normal collision and visibility rules still apply. Original feature identity and local identify remain.
